name: London System
author: LaionChess
description: A reliable system opening — Bf4, e3 and c3 against almost everything, with clear plans and ready answers to ...c5 and ...Qb6.

plies.note: Open with 1.d4 — occupy the center and free the c1 bishop.
The London bishop: develop it outside the pawn chain before playing e3.
Build the solid pyramid: e3 supports d4 and opens the f1 bishop.
Develop the knight toward e5.
Support d4 so the center stays rock solid against ...c5.
The knight goes to d2 to support e4 or f3.
Don't trade — retreat to g3 so Black's ...Bxf4 exf4 doesn't happen on his terms.
Put the bishop on its best diagonal, aiming at h7. Next comes O-O and a later e4 or Ne5.
